cards.text: What's the one thing you'd want to do to me that sounds too filthy to suggest? Say it anyway — the whole idea, and I promise you a real answer.
Which of your sounds would you be embarrassed to have recorded — and what would you be doing when it came out of you?
What's the position you secretly replay when you're alone? Describe it from the first touch to the finish — I want the details I've never heard.
If we had a completely empty house and one whole weekend, what are the first three things you'd drag me into?
What's the kink you'd ask for if I promised — right now, out loud — no judgment and a maybe? Here's the promise. Ask.
Slow-torture ride: get on top and move one slow inch at a time — five seconds down, five up — while they're forbidden from grabbing your hips or rushing you.
cards.speak: One inch at a time. Suffer beautifully for me.
cards.soften: One slow minute on top at your own comfortable pace.

cards.text: Hot-and-cold mouth round: alternate ice-cold and breath-warm mouth on the same spot — thirty seconds each — while they guess which they can't survive longer.
cards.speak: Cold again. Or do you want to beg for warm?
cards.soften: One ice-cool kiss followed by a warm one.

cards.text: Count their edges: hold them at the line as many times as you can in five minutes — counting each out loud, since they'll be too wrecked to count.
cards.speak: That's two. Three will cost you your voice.
cards.soften: One held edge, counted gently, then finish.

cards.text: Silent round: whatever they do to you for three minutes — no sound at all. Every moan leaks a forfeit. Your face does all the talking.
cards.speak: Make me be quiet. I dare you to try.
cards.soften: One quiet minute of slow touching, giggles allowed.

cards.text: Worship the part of them they hide: the one spot they are shy about. Slow mouth, slow hands, and praise until they believe every word.
cards.speak: This part of you drives me out of my mind. Let me prove it.
cards.soften: One sincere compliment about the part of them they are shy about.

cards.text: Needy switch: they take you how they want for five minutes — but every thirty seconds you say 'please don't stop' like you mean it.
cards.speak: Please don't stop. Please — I mean it.
cards.soften: Slow attentive round with one honest 'don't stop' whispered.

cards.text: Synchronized ruin: hands on each other, matching stroke for stroke — whoever finishes first sets up the other's round two exactly how they like it.
cards.soften: Slow mutual touching, no rules, trade the lead freely.

cards.text: Doorframe pin: catch them between you and the doorframe — hands above, mouth on their neck — and let them feel exactly how patient you plan to be tonight.
cards.speak: Caught you. You know what happens to things I catch.
cards.soften: One doorway kiss, hands free, unhurried.

cards.text: Undivided attention: they do nothing for three minutes — no reciprocating — while you adore every inch of them and refuse to be thanked.
cards.speak: Your only job is to lie there. Let me worship you properly.
cards.soften: One minute of all-about-them attention, no strings.

cards.text: Aftercare in the filthiest voice: once they're spent, stay exactly where you are and whisper what they just did to you — in the voice that started it all.
cards.speak: Look what you did to me. You're not allowed to fix it yet.
cards.soften: Stay close and whisper one thing you loved.

cards.text: Bed-to-floor-to-wall gauntlet: change locations three times without breaking apart — the planning between you out loud, dirty logistics allowed and encouraged.
cards.soften: Two locations, unhurried, laughing allowed.

cards.text: Ruined-and-owed: edge each other once, ruin it gently on purpose, then owe a full slow finish — traded roles, generous pace, all debts honored tonight.
cards.soften: One slow finish each, no games, full attention.

cards.text: Write their lines for them: what gets said to you at the exact moment you come — the words, the voice, the whole sentence. They perform it tonight.
Whose desperate face is better? Describe exactly what theirs looks like when you have taken them apart — and what yours looks like when they take you.
Plan tonight's encore: the one act you both want waiting at the end of this game — filthiest details welcome, executed the moment the deck goes dark.
Take them as deep as they can give you, hold there three seconds, come up breathing — then ask for it again. Twice more before you're done.
cards.speak: Watch me take all of you. Tell me when I get there.
cards.soften: Slow, deep kisses down their length — depth your choice, no holding.

cards.text: Throat round, consent-framed: they slide in slow, you set the depth by tapping their hip — twice means pause. Make them say how it feels.
cards.speak: Two taps means I breathe. Everything else means keep going.
cards.soften: Slow, shallow motion with your mouth while they guide gently.

cards.text: Spit in your palm, use it on them, and keep your eyes up while you do it — then dare them to return it. Whoever looks away first owes a finish.
cards.speak: Keep those eyes on me. You don't get to look away.
cards.soften: Use lube with slow, showy hands and held eye contact.

cards.text: Overstimulation round: make them come, then keep the exact same pace for thirty more seconds while they grip the sheets and beg. Safeword governs all.
cards.speak: You don't get to be done just because you came. Thirty more seconds.
cards.soften: Slow down to a tease the moment they finish, then stop with a kiss.

cards.text: The again-round: after they come once, say 'again' softly and build them right back up. They get two tonight, and they thank you out loud for each.
cards.speak: Again. You have one more in you — give it to me.
cards.soften: Build them to one finish with slow hands and a whispered good. That's all.

cards.text: Pin their hips down when they're close and slow everything to half speed — they watch you deny them and hear exactly why you're doing it.
cards.speak: I could let you. I'm choosing not to. Say thank you.
cards.soften: Ease the pace once at the peak, then finish them gently.

cards.text: Whose are you: joined, they answer 'yours' before every stroke and 'yours' after it — ten strokes each direction. Wrong or missing answer resets the count.
cards.soften: Joined, trading one 'yours' each for a slow minute.

cards.text: Use them tonight: they lie back, hands out of the way, and you take your pleasure at your pace while narrating exactly what you're using them for.
cards.speak: Still. You're mine to use until I say otherwise.
cards.soften: Take the pace you love for one slow minute while they watch.

cards.text: Fist a hand in their hair and set the rhythm with it — kissing, or lower. They feel the grip and ask before anything changes.
cards.speak: This hand sets the pace now. Keep up.
cards.soften: One hand resting at the back of their head during a slow kiss.

cards.text: What's the filthiest thing you've ever wanted them to say to you mid-act — the sentence that would wreck you? Say it now, in the exact voice.
How do you want to be taken the first time tonight — slow and owning, or hard and greedy? Describe the first thirty seconds like you're begging for them.
Describe the last time you almost couldn't stay quiet — where you were, what they were doing, and what sound nearly gave you away.
Mark them harder tonight: one bite high on the shoulder, one at the hip, one where you decide — and say what each one means as you leave it.
cards.speak: This one's mine. This one's for tomorrow. This one's so you remember.
cards.soften: Three slow kisses with the same spoken meanings.

cards.text: Spit round: use your mouth and nothing else — spit, press them open with your tongue, and take your time making them ask for more.
cards.speak: Wetter. You don't get fingers until you ask filthily.
cards.soften: Slow mouth only, plenty of time, no asking required.

cards.text: Mirror filth: joined in front of the mirror while one narrates exactly what the reflection shows — faces, grips, where you disappear into each other.
cards.soften: Watch yourselves kiss in the mirror for one slow minute.

cards.text: Deep course, night one: one lubed finger, five slow minutes, then two — and they ask out loud for the second one before it goes in. Praise the asking.
cards.speak: Ask me for the second one. I want to hear you want it.
cards.soften: One finger, unhurried, constant check-ins, all praise.

cards.text: The strap comes out: harness on, they choose the angle, you choose the pace — and you say what wearing it does to you while you use it on them.
cards.speak: Tell me how it feels. I've wanted to do this to you for months.
cards.soften: Harness on, one slow minute, hands and voice constant.

cards.text: Take them with the strap from behind, one hand fisted in their hair, the slowest hard rhythm you can hold — and make them say 'harder' before you give it.
cards.speak: You want harder? Then say the word and mean it.
cards.soften: Slow, careful, generous from behind with constant check-ins.

cards.text: What does the strap change for you — giving it, taking it, watching them wear it? Answer with the sentence you've never said out loud.
Whose mouth do you want on you right now, doing what, for how long — answer like they're already kneeling and waiting for their orders.
Silence rule, cruel version: they hold completely still while you use their body your way — every twitch adds thirty seconds. Count the additions out loud.
cards.speak: One. Keep still. Two. This is your fault now.
cards.soften: They rest still while you take one slow minute, no counting.

cards.text: Worship everything: mouth to their neck, chest, stomach, hips, thighs — spending thirty seconds each, saying what every part does to your self-control.
cards.speak: Every inch of you is a problem for me. Let me work through them all.
cards.soften: Three slow kisses with one compliment each, then trade.

cards.text: Loudest round: joined, and the volume is the dare — whoever moans quieter owes a forfeit the other invents. Nobody holds back and nobody wins quietly.
cards.soften: Joined and vocal for one slow minute, laughing allowed.

cards.text: Taste-yourself kiss: bring them to the edge with your mouth, finish them, then kiss them deep and make them taste it — ask first, and mean the ask.
cards.speak: Kiss me. You know where this mouth has been.
cards.soften: One deep kiss after slow, unhurried oral — no tasting required.

cards.text: Take-turns ruin: edge each other twice each, ruin it gently both times, then decide together who gets fully finished first — and how loudly they get to be.
cards.soften: One slow edge each, then a generous finish for both.

cards.text: Strangers who fuck on the first night: meet again in the hallway as if you've just gotten back — in character, hands already wandering, no names.
cards.speak: Your place or mine? Wrong answer — we're not making it that far.
cards.soften: Hold the stranger frame for one hallway kiss, then drop it laughing.

cards.text: The interview: they audition on their knees to be yours tonight — answering every question about what they're good at, in detail, while you watch.
cards.speak: Convince me. What exactly are you good at with your mouth?
cards.soften: Playful Q&A about what they love doing to you, no kneeling required.

cards.text: Owned for the next hour: they wear what you pick (or nothing), sit where you put them, and speak only when asked a direct question. Check in at the half hour.
cards.speak: Come here. Sit. You speak when you're spoken to — and you're spoken to often.
cards.soften: One hour of them following your lead with normal conversation allowed.

cards.text: The auction: each bids three 'favors' for what you want done to you tonight — highest bid wins and gets it exactly as described. Bids are owed, not negotiable.
cards.soften: Each names one wish and one favor to trade — both get granted this week.

cards.text: Slow-collapse fuck: start standing, end wherever you both give out — the floor, the bed, the wall — narrating the collapse while it happens.
cards.speak: I'm not making it to the bed and neither are you.
cards.soften: Start standing, finish lying down, unhurried.

cards.text: What's the most depraved thing you find unbelievably hot about them — the thought you'd never confess sober? You're not sober tonight. Confess.
Rank them: their mouth, their hands, their hips, their voice — what ruins you fastest, and what would you beg them to do with the winner right now?
Fuck them against the window, lights on, their hands on the glass, telling them exactly who could see if they looked up. Nobody does. That's the point.
cards.speak: Look out the window. Everyone below has no idea what you look like like this.
cards.soften: Stand together at the window, one slow joined minute, lights off.

cards.text: Pillow-prone: face down, hips up, held there by your hand flat on their back — the slowest deep rhythm you can manage while they thank you for every stroke.
cards.speak: Thank me. Every time. Out loud.
cards.soften: From behind, slow, with one thank-you each at the start and end.

cards.text: Breathless countdown: whoever is closest to the edge at sixty seconds gets finished; the other watches, hands behind back, narrating what they see.
cards.soften: One minute of slow mutual touching, finish whoever needs it.

cards.text: Hold their jaw, thumb on their chin, and make them answer every filthy question you ask while they're still catching their breath from the last round.
cards.speak: Look at me. Now tell me whose you are.
cards.soften: One held-gaze conversation about what you each want next.

cards.text: Messy round: no towels, no carefulness, nothing off the sheets — the mess is the point and it gets laughed about while it happens.
cards.speak: We're ruining these sheets and I'm not sorry at all.
cards.soften: One unhurried round with normal clean-up after.

cards.text: What would you want them to do to you if you promised total obedience for one hour — the full fantasy, in order, with the parts you'd normally skip?
Two-finger rule: everything tonight starts with two fingers and your mouth — they don't get more until they say precisely what two fingers are doing to them.
cards.speak: Use your words. What are my fingers doing to you right now?
cards.soften: Two fingers, slow mouth, check-ins every minute.

cards.text: Ruined on purpose: bring them all the way up, then stop dead — hands off, thirty seconds, both of you breathing — before you finish them twice as slow.
cards.speak: That was on purpose. Now you get it twice as slow.
cards.soften: One slow pause at the peak, then finish them gently.

cards.text: Same words, different mouths: one shared phrase picked at the start — 'use me' — whoever breaks and says it first, the other makes true, immediately.
cards.soften: Pick one shared phrase, say it once each, make it true gently.

cards.text: Toy debut, tonight: unbox the one you picked together, and take turns being the first one it's used on — the second gets to watch and call the settings.
cards.speak: New toy. Old rules. Safeword stands — and I'm starting with you.
cards.soften: Unbox together and plan the debut for tomorrow.

cards.text: Whole-night stake: rock-paper-scissors winner owns the rest of the night — every pace, position, finish — and the loser says 'yes' to each new rule.
cards.speak: Best of one. And when I win, I'm not going easy on you.
cards.soften: Winner picks the next three cards, loser approves them.

cards.text: When was the last time you thought about this game mid-act — and what did you want the app to dare you both next? Say the dare you wanted.
Finish on their terms: they choose the position, the pace, the words, and whether you come before or after they do — your only input is 'thank you'.
cards.speak: Your call. I'll thank you for whatever you decide.
cards.soften: They pick the position, you set a comfortable pace together.

cards.text: No-hands duel: both of you, mouths only, trying to make the other break first — hands behind your own back. First to grab the other with their hands loses.
cards.soften: Take turns with mouths only, one slow minute each, hands allowed to hold.

cards.text: The long goodbye: one hour before anyone finishes — edging, teasing, positions changing — and every ten minutes each names what you're saving up for.
cards.speak: One hour. Every ten minutes, say it: what are you saving this for?
cards.soften: Twenty slow minutes of teasing, then a generous finish.

cards.text: Describe the exact moment tonight you want to remember in a week — where their body is, what sound they make, what you say — then go make it real.
Mutual ruin, simultaneous: hands on each other, matching pace, and you finish together or you start over — as many restarts as it takes, laughing through them.
cards.soften: Slow mutual finish, no matching rules.

cards.text: Plan the encore while you recover: the filthiest fifteen minutes tonight unlocked — scheduled before the night ends, no vetoes.
